correctness.rationale: Read Cui et al. original primary full PDF equation (3.2): all four diagonal entries are z=λ+a e^(−λθ). Exact determinant expansion of the printed 4×4 matrix gives F(z)=z⁴+3z²−z+1, and expansion in delayed powers matches paper (3.3). For a=1/4, F(λ+1/4)=λ⁴+λ³+(27/8)λ²+(9/16)λ+241/256 has positive Hurwitz determinants 1,45/16,41/64 and 241·41/(256·64). The four simple roots of F have real parts ±r where r² is the unique positive zero of 64q³+96q²+20q−1, with r≈0.20372326785<1/4. Write their positive imaginary parts y1≈0.560667728 and y2≈1.663928496, s=√(1/16−r²)≈0.14490283, α=acos(4r)≈0.61825. Exhaustive phase equations produce frequencies y1+s,y2+s,y2−s,y1−s and their least nonnegative delay representatives 0.87624353,1.39501178,2.47516838,13.62532935 respectively. No later branch wraps give an earlier delay. Implicit differentiation yields Re λ′=ω*s/[(1−rθ)²+(sθ)²]≈0.1479657>0 at first crossing. Spectral continuity and the fixed disks |λ−z_j|≤1/4 in Re λ≥0 prevent unstable roots from arriving at infinity. Max crossing frequency 1.8088313<2.0083. The computations support the exact finite-branch algebra, not nonlinear Hopf claims.
residual_risks: Stable interval concerns linear asymptotic stability of the zero equilibrium only.
Numerical digits come from algebraic roots and phase values, not certified arbitrary precision beyond stated rounding.

value.rationale: The exact scalar shift splits a four-dimensional characteristic equation into four simple scalar delay branches, supplies all crossing frequencies and replaces an impossible published numerical Hopf benchmark with an exact linear stability margin. Structural diagnosis and a meaningful correction are independently useful, not mere decimal adjustment.
residual_risks: Does not establish nonlinear branch criticality, direction, periodic orbit stability or hybrid control.

final_claim: For Cui et al. printed four-neuron common-delay BAM linearization, the characteristic determinant is F(λ+a e^(−λθ)), F(z)=z⁴+3z²−z+1. At a=1/4 the first crossing has (ω*,θ*)=(0.705570557982711…,0.876243533775502…), transverse speed Re λ′≈0.147965713761474>0; zero-delay stability persists until θ*. Published frequency 2.0083 cannot occur for any delay, within the stated linear problem only.
limitations: Linear stability only; no nonlinear Hopf criticality.
